<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,viewport-fit=cover">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#0b0b0e">
<meta name="color-scheme" content="dark">
<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-capable" content="yes">
<meta name="mobile-web-app-capable" content="yes">
<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-title" content="ShotPulse">
<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-status-bar-style" content="black">
<title>ShotPulse</title>
<link rel="manifest" href="/manifest.webmanifest">
<link rel="icon" href="data:image/png;base64,">
<link rel="apple-touch-icon" href="/apple-touch-icon.png">
<style>
@font-face{font-family:'Inter';font-style:normal;font-weight:500;font-display:swap;src:url(data:font/woff;base64,) format('woff')}
@font-face{font-family:'Inter';font-style:normal;font-weight:700;font-display:swap;src:url(data:font/woff;base64,) format('woff')}
@font-face{font-family:'Inter';font-style:normal;font-weight:900;font-display:swap;src:url(data:font/woff;base64,) format('woff')}
:root{
  --bg:#0b0b0e; --bg2:#101014; --panel:#17171c; --panel2:#1f1f26; --panel3:#272730; --line:#2c2c36; --line2:#3a3a46;
  --text:#f6f6f8; --muted:#9a9aa8; --faint:#6c6c7a;
  --accent:#14acfd; --accent2:#4cc2ff; --accent-ink:#021522;
  --good:#37d083; --bad:#ff5a5f; --gold:#ffd23f; --blue:#4aa8ff;
  --r:18px; --r-sm:12px;
  --font:'Inter',-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',Roboto,'Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif;
  --disp:'Inter',-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',Roboto,Arial,sans-serif;
  --safe-b:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px); --safe-t:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);
}
*{box-sizing:border-box;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}
html,body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);font-family:var(--font);font-size:16px;line-height:1.35;-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%;touch-action:manipulation}
body{min-height:100vh;min-height:100dvh;overscroll-behavior-y:none}
button,input,select,textarea{font:inherit;color:inherit}
button{cursor:pointer;touch-action:manipulation}
h1,h2,h3,p{margin:0}
.disp{font-family:var(--disp);font-weight:900;letter-spacing:-.03em;text-transform:uppercase}
.muted{color:var(--muted)} .faint{color:var(--faint)} .small{font-size:13px} .tiny{font-size:11px}
.row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px} .col{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px}
.grow{flex:1;min-width:0} .center{text-align:center} .hide{display:none!important}
.ellip{white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.num{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
svg.i{width:22px;height:22px;stroke:currentColor;fill:none;stroke-width:2;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;flex:none}

/* ---------- shell ---------- */
#app{max-width:760px;margin:0 auto;min-height:100vh;min-height:100dvh;padding-bottom:calc(86px + var(--safe-b))}
#app.full{padding-bottom:0;max-width:900px}
.top{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:30;background:var(--bg,#0b0b0e);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);padding:calc(10px + var(--safe-t)) 16px 10px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;min-height:56px}
.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;font-family:var(--disp);font-weight:900;font-size:20px;letter-spacing:-.02em;text-transform:uppercase}
.puck{width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%,#444,#111 70%);border:2px solid var(--accent);box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #0b0b0e inset;position:relative;flex:none}
.puck:after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--accent)}
.title{font-weight:800;font-size:19px;letter-spacing:-.01em}
.iconbtn{width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid #55556a;background:#2a2a34;display:grid;place-items:center;color:var(--text);flex:none}
.iconbtn:active{background:var(--panel3)}
.page{padding:16px}
.sect{margin:22px 0 10px;font-size:12px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.09em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.sect .grow{height:1px;background:var(--line)}
.card{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r);padding:14px}
.card + .card{margin-top:12px}

.tabs{position:fixed;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;z-index:40;background:#0e0e12;border-top:1px solid var(--line);display:flex;justify-content:center;padding-bottom:var(--safe-b)}
.tabs .in{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);width:100%;max-width:760px}
.tab{background:none;border:0;padding:9px 4px 8px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:3px;color:var(--muted);font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.02em;min-height:60px}
.tab.on{color:var(--accent)}
.tab svg.i{width:24px;height:24px}

/* ---------- controls ---------- */
.btn{border:0;border-radius:14px;min-height:50px;padding:0 18px;font-weight:800;font-size:16px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;background:var(--panel3);color:var(--text);border:1px solid var(--line2)}
.btn:active{transform:scale(.98);filter:brightness(1.15)}
.btn.primary{background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--accent2),var(--accent));color:var(--accent-ink);border-color:transparent;box-shadow:0 6px 20px rgba(20,172,253,.28)}
.btn.ghost{background:transparent}
.btn.danger{background:rgba(255,90,95,.12);color:var(--bad);border-color:rgba(255,90,95,.35)}
.btn.block{width:100%} .btn.big{min-height:62px;font-size:18px;border-radius:16px}
.btn.sm{min-height:40px;padding:0 13px;font-size:14px;border-radius:11px}
.btn[disabled]{opacity:.4;pointer-events:none}
.field{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px}
.field>label,.lbl{font-size:12px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.07em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted)}
.inp{width:100%;min-height:50px;border-radius:13px;border:1px solid var(--line2);background:var(--bg2);padding:0 14px;font-size:16px;outline:none}
.inp:focus{border-color:var(--accent);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(20,172,253,.18)}
select.inp{appearance:none;-webkit-appearance:none;background-image:linear-gradient(45deg,transparent 50%,var(--muted) 50%),linear-gradient(135deg,var(--muted) 50%,transparent 50%);background-position:calc(100% - 20px) 22px,calc(100% - 14px) 22px;background-size:6px 6px;background-repeat:no-repeat;padding-right:34px}
.chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px}
.chip{min-height:44px;padding:0 15px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid var(--line2);background:var(--panel2);font-weight:700;font-size:15px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px}
.chip.on{background:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent);color:var(--accent-ink)}
.chip:active{filter:brightness(1.2)}
.seg{display:grid;grid-auto-flow:column;grid-auto-columns:1fr;background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--line2);border-radius:14px;padding:4px;gap:4px}
.seg button{min-height:42px;border:0;border-radius:10px;background:transparent;color:var(--muted);font-weight:800;font-size:14px}
.seg button.on{background:var(--panel3);color:var(--text);box-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.06) inset}
.pill{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;border-radius:999px;padding:3px 10px;font-size:12px;font-weight:800;background:var(--panel3);color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:.03em}
.pill.live{background:rgba(255,90,95,.15);color:#ff7478}
.pill.final{background:var(--panel3);color:var(--muted)}
.pill.w{background:rgba(55,208,131,.15);color:var(--good)} .pill.l{background:rgba(255,90,95,.14);color:var(--bad)} .pill.t{background:rgba(255,210,63,.14);color:var(--gold)} .pill.o{background:rgba(255,141,66,.16);color:var(--accent2)}
.dot{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:currentColor;flex:none}
.pulse{animation:pulse 1.4s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes pulse{0%,100%{opacity:1}50%{opacity:.35}}
.swatches{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;align-items:center}
.sw{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:50%;border:3px solid transparent;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px var(--line2) inset}
.sw.on{border-color:#fff}
.colorpick{position:relative;width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:50%;overflow:hidden;border:1px dashed var(--muted);display:grid;place-items:center;color:var(--muted);font-weight:800}
.colorpick input{position:absolute;inset:-6px;width:60px;height:60px;opacity:0;cursor:pointer}

/* ---------- themed backgrounds ---------- */
.themed{position:relative;background-color:var(--c1,#222);background-size:cover;background-position:center;isolation:isolate;overflow:hidden}
.themed:before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(0,0,0,.18),rgba(0,0,0,.62));z-index:-1}
.logo{width:40px;height:40px;object-fit:contain;flex:none;filter:drop-shadow(0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.5))}

/* ---------- lists ---------- */
.list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px}
.item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:12px 14px;border-radius:var(--r);background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);min-height:64px;text-align:left;width:100%}
.item:active{background:var(--panel2)}
.teamcard{border-radius:var(--r);padding:16px;min-height:104px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:flex-end;gap:2px;color:#fff;text-align:left;width:100%;border:1px solid var(--line2)}
.teamcard .nm{font-size:26px;line-height:1.05;}
.teamcard .sub{font-size:13px;font-weight:700;opacity:.9;}
.empty{border:1px dashed var(--line2);border-radius:var(--r);padding:28px 18px;text-align:center;color:var(--muted)}
.gcard{display:block;width:100%;text-align:left;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--panel);border-radius:var(--r);padding:0;overflow:hidden}
.gcard:active{background:var(--panel2)}
.gcard .bar{height:6px;display:flex} .gcard .bar i{flex:1}
.gcard .body{padding:12px 14px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px}
.gline{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
.gline .t{flex:1;min-width:0;font-weight:800;font-size:16px}
.gline .s{font-weight:900;font-size:22px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}

/* ---------- tables ---------- */
.tbl{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.tbl th,.tbl td{padding:9px 5px;text-align:center;font-size:14px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.tbl th{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.07em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);font-weight:800;white-space:nowrap}
.tbl td:first-child,.tbl th:first-child{text-align:left;padding-left:2px}
.tbl tr:last-child td{border-bottom:0}
.tbl .cur{background:rgba(20,172,253,.09)}
.tbl .tot{font-weight:900}
.tbl.sortable th{cursor:pointer;padding:12px 4px}
.tbl.sortable th.on{color:var(--accent)}
.tbl.sortable tbody tr{cursor:pointer}
.tbl.sortable tbody tr:active{background:var(--panel2)}
.row>.tdot{margin-right:0}
.tdot{display:inline-block;width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;margin-right:7px;vertical-align:baseline;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.25)}
.tiles{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:8px}
.tile{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:10px 8px;text-align:center}
.tile b{display:block;font-size:24px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:-.02em;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.tile span{font-size:11px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.07em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted)}
.hscroll{display:flex;gap:8px;overflow-x:auto;padding:2px 0 6px;scrollbar-width:none;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch}
.hscroll::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
.hscroll .chip{flex:none}

/* ---------- modal / sheet ---------- */
.scrim{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:100;background:rgba(0,0,0,.62);display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:center;animation:fade .15s ease-out}
@keyframes fade{from{opacity:0}to{opacity:1}}
@keyframes rise{from{transform:translateY(30px);opacity:.4}to{transform:none;opacity:1}}
.sheet{width:100%;max-width:560px;max-height:92dvh;overflow:auto;background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line2);border-radius:24px 24px 0 0;padding:18px 16px calc(18px + var(--safe-b));animation:rise .2s ease-out;overscroll-behavior:contain}
.scrim.mid{align-items:center;padding:16px}
.scrim.mid .sheet{border-radius:24px}
.sheet h2{font-size:20px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:-.01em;margin-bottom:12px}
.sheet .acts{display:flex;gap:10px;margin-top:16px}
.sheet .acts .btn{flex:1}
.grabzone{height:40px;margin:-18px -16px 4px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;touch-action:none;cursor:grab}
.grab{width:46px;height:5px;border-radius:3px;background:var(--line2)}
.sheet h2{touch-action:none}
.scrim{cursor:pointer} .sheet{cursor:auto}
.prow{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;width:100%;min-height:64px;padding:10px 14px;border-radius:14px;border:1px solid var(--line2);background:var(--panel2);text-align:left;font-size:17px;font-weight:800}
.prow.on{border-color:var(--accent);background:rgba(20,172,253,.12)}
.prow .tag{margin-left:auto;font-size:11px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.08em;color:var(--accent)}
.toast{position:fixed;left:50%;top:calc(64px + var(--safe-t));bottom:auto;transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:200;background:#25252d;border:1px solid var(--line2);color:#fff;padding:12px 16px;border-radius:14px;font-weight:700;font-size:14px;box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.5);max-width:90vw;animation:rise .2s ease-out}

/* ---------- tracker ---------- */
.trk-screen{min-height:100vh;min-height:100dvh;display:flex;flex-direction:column;padding-bottom:var(--safe-b)}
.trk-bar{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:calc(8px + var(--safe-t)) 10px 8px}
.trk-bar .mid{flex:1;min-width:0;text-align:center;font-weight:800;font-size:14px;color:#fff}
.livepill{height:44px;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid #55556a;background:#2a2a34;padding:0 12px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-weight:800;font-size:13px;flex:none}
.livepill.on{border-color:rgba(255,90,95,.5);color:#ff7a7e}
.livepill.off{color:#d4d4de}
.ptabs{display:flex;gap:6px;padding:0 10px 8px;overflow-x:auto;scrollbar-width:none}
.ptabs::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
.ptab{flex:1;min-width:58px;min-height:46px;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid #55556a;background:#2a2a34;font-weight:900;font-size:16px;color:#e4e4ec}
.ptab.on{background:#fff;color:#111;border-color:#fff}
.ptab.add{flex:none;min-width:50px}
.board{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;margin:0 10px;border-radius:20px;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid var(--line2);position:relative}
.half{padding:12px 12px 10px;color:#fff;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;min-height:128px}
.half .hd{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;min-width:0}
.half .nm{font-weight:900;font-size:17px;letter-spacing:-.01em;line-height:1.1;min-width:0}
.half .ha{font-size:10px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.1em;opacity:.8}
.half .goals{font-family:var(--disp);font-weight:900;font-size:64px;line-height:.95;letter-spacing:-.04em;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.half .sog{font-weight:800;font-size:13px;opacity:.92;display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:baseline}
.half .sog b{font-size:20px;font-weight:900;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.half .nm.ellip{white-space:normal;display:-webkit-box;-webkit-line-clamp:2;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;overflow:hidden;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.half.r{align-items:flex-end;text-align:right}
.half.r .hd{flex-direction:row-reverse}
.half.r .sog{flex-direction:row-reverse}
.pbadge{position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:11px;transform:translateX(-50%);background:#fff;color:#111;border-radius:999px;font-weight:900;font-size:13px;padding:3px 11px;letter-spacing:.04em;z-index:2;box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.4)}
.pads{flex:1;min-height:330px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px;padding:10px}
.padcol{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;min-height:0;padding:8px;border-radius:26px;border:1px solid var(--line2)}
.shot,.goal{border:0;border-radius:22px;width:100%;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:2px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;user-select:none;-webkit-user-select:none;transition:transform .06s ease-out,filter .06s}
.shot{flex:3;min-height:120px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--b1l),var(--b1));color:var(--on1);border:4px solid rgba(255,255,255,.88);box-shadow:0 10px 26px rgba(0,0,0,.45)}
.shot .w{font-family:var(--disp);font-weight:900;font-size:clamp(34px,11vw,64px);letter-spacing:-.03em;line-height:1}
.shot .n{font-weight:800;font-size:15px;opacity:.85}
.goal{flex:2;min-height:96px;background:#fff;color:#111;border:4px solid var(--gold);box-shadow:0 10px 26px rgba(0,0,0,.4)}
.goal .w{font-family:var(--disp);font-weight:900;font-size:clamp(28px,9vw,48px);letter-spacing:-.03em;line-height:1}
.goal .n{font-weight:800;font-size:14px;color:#555}
.shot:active,.goal:active{transform:scale(.965);filter:brightness(1.12)}
.shot.flash:after,.goal.flash:after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:#fff;opacity:.0;animation:flash .35s ease-out}
@keyframes flash{0%{opacity:.55}100%{opacity:0}}
.bump{animation:bump .28s ease-out}
@keyframes bump{0%{transform:scale(1)}35%{transform:scale(1.18)}100%{transform:scale(1)}}
.net{flex:none;min-height:60px;border-radius:16px;border:1px solid var(--line2);background:rgba(0,0,0,.55);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:6px 12px;text-align:left;color:#fff;width:100%}
.net .k{font-size:10px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.1em;color:var(--muted)}
.net .v{font-weight:900;font-size:16px;line-height:1.1}
.net.warn{border-color:#ff8a2a}
.undo{margin:0 10px 10px;min-height:64px;border-radius:18px;border:1px solid var(--line2);background:var(--panel2);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:12px;font-weight:900;font-size:17px;width:calc(100% - 20px)}
.undo small{font-weight:700;color:var(--muted);font-size:13px}
.undo:active{background:var(--panel3)}
.undo[disabled]{opacity:.4}
.fixrow{display:flex;gap:10px;margin:0 10px 10px}
.fixrow .undo{margin:0;width:auto;flex:1.5;min-width:0}
.fixrow .undo.fix{flex:1;background:rgba(20,172,253,.12);border-color:rgba(20,172,253,.45)}
.fixgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px}
.fixgrid .btn{min-height:60px;font-weight:900;font-size:17px}
.evrow .evmain{all:unset;box-sizing:border-box;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;flex:1;min-width:0;min-height:56px;cursor:pointer}
.evrow .evdel{width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:14px;border:1px solid var(--line2);background:var(--panel2);color:#ff6b6b;display:grid;place-items:center;flex:none}
.below{padding:6px 12px 40px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}
.evrow{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:10px 4px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);width:100%;background:none;border-left:0;border-right:0;border-top:0;text-align:left;min-height:52px}
.evrow:last-child{border-bottom:0}
.evic{width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:9px;display:grid;place-items:center;font-weight:900;font-size:12px;flex:none}
.evic.s{background:var(--panel3);color:var(--muted)} .evic.g{background:var(--gold);color:#111}
.gl{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 34px 34px 34px 60px;gap:8px 4px;align-items:center;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;text-align:right}
.gl .nm{text-align:left}
.gl .h:first-child{text-align:left}
.gl .h{font-size:11px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.07em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted)}
.gl .nm{font-weight:800}

/* ---------- viewer ---------- */
.vwr .board{margin:0;border-radius:0 0 24px 24px;border-width:0 0 1px}
.vwr .half{min-height:170px;padding:16px 14px 12px}
.vwr .half .goals{font-size:92px}
.vwr .half .nm{font-size:20px}
.vwr .half .sog b{font-size:26px}
.vbar{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:calc(10px + var(--safe-t)) 14px 10px}
.banner{margin:10px 12px 0;padding:10px 14px;border-radius:12px;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;background:rgba(255,210,63,.12);color:var(--gold);border:1px solid rgba(255,210,63,.3)}
.qrbox{background:#fff;border-radius:18px;padding:10px;width:min(78vw,260px);margin:0 auto}
.qrbox svg{display:block;width:100%;height:auto}
.linkbox{font-size:13px;word-break:break-all;background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--line2);border-radius:12px;padding:10px 12px;color:var(--muted);user-select:all}

/* ---------- team editor ---------- */

/* ---------- image upload helpers ---------- */
function loadImage(file) {
  return new Promise((res, rej) => { const url = URL.createObjectURL(file), img = new Image(); img.onload = () => { URL.revokeObjectURL(url); res(img); }; img.onerror = () => { URL.revokeObjectURL(url); rej(new Error('Could not read that image.')); }; img.src = url; });
}
async function resizeImage(file, maxDim, kind) {
  const img = await loadImage(file); const iw = img.naturalWidth || img.width || maxDim, ih = img.naturalHeight || img.height || maxDim;
  const sc = Math.min(1, maxDim / Math.max(iw, ih)); const w = Math.max(1, Math.round(iw * sc)), h = Math.max(1, Math.round(ih * sc));
  const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = w; c.height = h; const ctx = c.getContext('2d');
  if (kind === 'bg') { ctx.fillStyle = '#000'; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h); }
  ctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0, w, h);
  if (kind === 'bg') return c.toDataURL('image/jpeg', .62);
  let u = c.toDataURL('image/webp', .9); if (!u.startsWith('data:image/webp')) u = c.toDataURL('image/png');
  return u;
}

/* ---- live.js ---- */
/* =====================================================================
   Live sharing: publish snapshots (offline-safe) + spectator polling
   ===================================================================== */
const Live = (() => {
  const CHARS = 'ABCDEFGHJKMNPQRSTUVWXYZ23456789';
  let timer = null, busy = false, fails = 0, lastStart = 0;
  const state = { lastOk: 0, err: '' };
  const viewers = {};   // game code -> people watching now (null = unknown)
  const emit = () => window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('st-live'));
  const rand = n => { const a = new Uint8Array(n); crypto.getRandomValues(a); return a; };
  const randCode = () => [...rand(6)].map(x => CHARS[x % CHARS.length]).join('');
  const randKey = () => [...rand(16)].map(x => x.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
  const pendingDeletes = () => { try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('st.pendingDel') || '[]'); } catch (e) { return []; } };
  const setPending = a => { try { localStorage.setItem('st.pendingDel', JSON.stringify(a)); } catch (e) { /* ignore */ } };

  function apiBase() {
    const b = norm(S.settings.liveBase).replace(/\/+$/, '');
    if (b) return b;
    return /^https?:$/.test(location.protocol) ? location.origin : '';
  }
  const shareURL = g => { const b = apiBase(); return b && g.live ? `${b}/?live=${g.live.code}` : ''; };
  /* never start two uploads <1.1s apart: KV allows one write per key per second */
  function schedule(ms) { clearTimeout(timer); timer = setTimeout(flush, Math.max(ms, 1100 - (Date.now() - lastStart))); }

  function enable(g) {
    if (!g.live) g.live = { code: randCode(), key: randKey(), on: false, rev: 0, ver: 0, dirty: true };
    g.live.on = true; g.live.dirty = true; g.live.ver++;
    save('games'); schedule(50); emit();
  }
  async function disable(g, silent) {
    const l = g.live; if (!l) return;
    g.live = null; save('games');
    const list = pendingDeletes(); list.push({ code: l.code, key: l.key }); setPending(list);
    if (!silent) emit();
    schedule(50);
  }
  function touch(g) { if (g && g.live && g.live.on) { g.live.dirty = true; g.live.ver++; schedule(250); } }

  async function flush() {
    if (busy) return;
    const base = apiBase();
    const gs = S.games.filter(g => g.live && g.live.on && g.live.dirty);
    const dels = pendingDeletes();
    if (!gs.length && !dels.length) { emit(); return; }
    if (!base) { state.err = 'nosrv'; emit(); return; }
    if (!navigator.onLine) { emit(); return; }
    busy = true; lastStart = Date.now();
    try {
      for (const g of gs) {
        const l = g.live, ver = l.ver; l.rev++;
        const ctl = new AbortController(), to = setTimeout(() => ctl.abort(), 9000); let res;
        try { res = await fetch(`${base}/api/live/${l.code}`, { method: 'PUT', headers: Object.assign({ 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'X-Write-Key': l.key }, Acct.A() && Acct.A().dev ? { 'X-Dev': Acct.A().dev } : {}), body: JSON.stringify({ rev: l.rev, data: snapshotOf(g) }), signal: ctl.signal }); }
        finally { clearTimeout(to); }
        if (res.status === 402) { l.on = false; l.dirty = false; save('games'); state.err = 'plan'; toast('Live link stopped. It needs a team plan.'); continue; }
        if (res.status === 403) { l.code = randCode(); l.key = randKey(); l.rev = 0; l.dirty = true; save('games'); schedule(50); continue; }
        if (res.status === 429) { if (!state.told) { state.told = true; toast('Too many new live links from this network right now. It will keep trying.'); } throw new Error('busy'); }
        if (!res.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + res.status);
        try { const pj = await res.clone().json(); if (pj && typeof pj.viewers === 'number') viewers[l.code] = pj.viewers; } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
        if (l.ver === ver) l.dirty = false; else schedule(300);
        state.lastOk = Date.now(); state.err = ''; fails = 0; save('games');
      }
      if (dels.length) {
        const left = [];
        for (const d of dels) { try { const r = await fetch(`${base}/api/live/${d.code}`, { method: 'DELETE', headers: { 'X-Write-Key': d.key } }); if (!(r.ok || r.status === 404 || r.status === 403)) left.push(d); } catch (e) { left.push(d); } }
        setPending(left); if (left.length) throw new Error('delete pending');
      }
    } catch (e) {
      fails++; state.err = String((e && e.message) || e);
      schedule(Math.min(30000, 2000 * Math.pow(2, fails - 1)));
    } finally { busy = false; emit(); }
  }
  /* what to tell the scorer */
  function info(g) {
    if (!g || !g.live || !g.live.on) return { on: false, kind: 'off', text: 'Live off' };
    if (!apiBase()) return { on: true, kind: 'warn', text: 'Set server' };
    if (!g.live.dirty) { const n = viewers[g.live.code]; return { on: true, kind: 'ok', text: n > 0 ? 'Live · 👁 ' + n : 'Live' }; }
    if (!navigator.onLine) return { on: true, kind: 'offline', text: 'Offline · saved' };
    return { on: true, kind: fails ? 'warn' : 'sync', text: fails ? 'Retrying…' : 'Syncing…' };
  }
  /* every 20 s ask the server how many people are watching each live game */
  async function pollViewers() {
    if (document.hidden || !navigator.onLine) return;
    const base = apiBase(); if (!base) return;
    let changed = false;
    for (const g of S.games.filter(x => x.live && x.live.on)) {
      const ctl = new AbortController(), to = setTimeout(() => ctl.abort(), 6000);
      try {
        const r = await fetch(`${base}/api/live/${g.live.code}?count=1`, { cache: 'no-store', headers: { 'X-Write-Key': g.live.key }, signal: ctl.signal });
        if (r.ok) { const j = await r.json(); const n = typeof j.viewers === 'number' ? j.viewers : null; if (viewers[g.live.code] !== n) { viewers[g.live.code] = n; changed = true; } }
      } catch (e) { /* ignore */ } finally { clearTimeout(to); }
    }
    if (changed) emit();
  }
  function boot() {
    setInterval(pollViewers, 20000);
    window.addEventListener('online', () => { fails = 0; schedule(300); emit(); });
    window.addEventListener('offline', emit);
    if (S.games.some(g => g.live && g.live.on && g.live.dirty) || pendingDeletes().length) schedule(1500);
  }

  /* ---------- spectator side ---------- */
  function viewerApi() {
    const p = new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('api');
    if (p && /^https?:\/\//.test(p)) return p.replace(/\/+$/, '');
    if (/^https?:$/.test(location.protocol)) return location.origin;
    return norm(S.settings.liveBase).replace(/\/+$/, '');
  }
  function watch(code, onData, onState) {
    let rev = 0, stopped = false, t = null, had = false, lastHi = 0, fin = false, lastChange = Date.now(); const api = viewerApi();
    const vid = [...crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(12))].map(x => CHARS[x % CHARS.length]).join('');   // random anonymous id, only used to count viewers
    async function tick() {
      if (stopped) return;
      let delay = fin ? 60000 : document.hidden ? 12000 : Date.now() - lastChange > 180000 ? 4000 : 2000;   // final: once a minute; quiet for 3 min: every 4 s
      const ctl = new AbortController(), to = setTimeout(() => ctl.abort(), 8000);
      try {
        const hi = Date.now() - lastHi > 20000; if (hi) lastHi = Date.now();
        const res = await fetch(`${api}/api/live/${encodeURIComponent(code)}?rev=${rev}${hi ? '&v=' + vid : ''}`, { cache: 'no-store', signal: ctl.signal });
        if (res.status === 404) onState(had ? 'ended' : 'notfound');
        else if (res.ok) { const j = await res.json(); if (!j.unchanged) { rev = j.rev; had = true; lastChange = Date.now(); fin = !!(j.data && j.data.status === 'final'); onData(j.data, j.updated); } onState('ok'); }
        else onState('error');
      } catch (e) { onState('offline'); delay = 5000; }
      finally { clearTimeout(to); }
      if (!stopped) t = setTimeout(tick, delay);
    }
    const kick = () => { if (!document.hidden) { clearTimeout(t); tick(); } };
    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', kick); window.addEventListener('online', kick);
    tick();
    return () => { stopped = true; clearTimeout(t); document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange', kick); window.removeEventListener('online', kick); };
  }
  return { enable, disable, touch, flush, info, boot, apiBase, shareURL, watch, state, viewers };
})();

/* ---- backup.js ---- */
/* =====================================================================
   Backup history: automatic snapshots kept inside the browser (IndexedDB),
   a reminder to save a real backup FILE, and a request for protected storage.
   ===================================================================== */
const Bak = (() => {
  const DB = 'shotpulse-backups', ST = 'snaps', KEEP = 12, DAY = 86400000;
  const state = { persisted: null };
  const open = () => new Promise((res, rej) => { try { const r = indexedDB.open(DB, 1); r.onupgradeneeded = () => r.result.createObjectStore(ST, { keyPath: 'id' }); r.onsuccess = () => res(r.result); r.onerror = () => rej(r.error); } catch (e) { rej(e); } });
  async function all() {
    const db = await open();
    return new Promise((res, rej) => { const q = db.transaction(ST, 'readonly').objectStore(ST).getAll(); q.onsuccess = () => { db.close(); res(q.result.sort((a, b) => b.ts - a.ts)); }; q.onerror = () => { db.close(); rej(q.error); }; });
  }
  const meta = r => ({ id: r.id, ts: r.ts, reason: r.reason, games: r.games, teams: r.teams, size: r.json.length });
  async function list() { try { return (await all()).map(meta); } catch (e) { return []; } }
  async function put(rec) {
    const db = await open();
    return new Promise((res, rej) => { const t = db.transaction(ST, 'readwrite'); t.objectStore(ST).put(rec); t.oncomplete = () => { db.close(); res(); }; t.onerror = () => { db.close(); rej(t.error); }; });
  }
  async function drop(id) {
    const db = await open();
    return new Promise((res, rej) => { const t = db.transaction(ST, 'readwrite'); t.objectStore(ST).delete(id); t.oncomplete = () => { db.close(); res(); }; t.onerror = () => { db.close(); rej(t.error); }; });
  }
  async function get(id) { return (await all()).find(r => r.id === id) || null; }
  const sig = txt => hashStr(txt) + ':' + txt.length;
  /* take a snapshot (skips if nothing changed since the last one) */
  async function snap(reason, force) {
    try {
      if (!S.teams.length && !S.games.length) return false;
      const json = exportData(), cur = sig(json), rows = await all();
      if (!force && rows[0] && rows[0].sig === cur) return false;
      await put({ id: Date.now().toString(36) + uid().slice(0, 3), ts: Date.now(), reason, sig: cur, games: S.games.length, teams: S.teams.length, json });
      const left = (await all()).slice(KEEP); for (const r of left) await drop(r.id);
      return true;
    } catch (e) { return false; }
  }
  async function restore(id) {
    const r = await get(id); if (!r) throw new Error('That backup is gone.');
    await snap('Before restore', true);
    importData(r.json);
  }
  /* iPhones/iPads can't save a downloaded file from an installed web app, so hand the file to the share sheet ("Save to Files") there; everywhere else it downloads */
  const isIOS = () => /iPad|iPhone|iPod/.test(navigator.userAgent) || (navigator.platform === 'MacIntel' && navigator.maxTouchPoints > 1);
  async function download(json, name) {
    name = name || `shotpulse-backup-${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}.json`;
    try {
      if (isIOS() && typeof File === 'function' && navigator.share && navigator.canShare) {
        const f = new File([json], name, { type: 'application/json' });
        if (navigator.canShare({ files: [f] })) { try { await navigator.share({ files: [f], title: 'ShotPulse backup' }); return true; } catch (e) { if (e && e.name === 'AbortError') return false; } }
      }
    } catch (e) { /* fall back to a normal download */ }
    const a = h('a', { href: URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([json], { type: 'application/json' })), download: name });
    document.body.append(a); a.click(); setTimeout(() => { URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href); a.remove(); }, 4000);
    return true;
  }
  const fileInfo = () => S.settings.bk || { ts: 0, games: 0 };
  const finals = () => S.games.filter(g => g.status === 'final').length;
  async function downloadNow() { const done = await download(exportData()); if (done) { S.settings.bk = { ts: Date.now(), games: finals() }; save('settings'); } return done; }
  /* after a game ends: nudge for a real backup file every 5 finished games or 3 weeks */
  function remind() {
    const bk = fileInfo(), f = finals(), fresh = f - (bk.games || 0);
    if (fresh >= 5 || (fresh >= 1 && bk.ts && Date.now() - bk.ts > 21 * DAY)) toastAction('Save a backup file of your teams and games?', 'Save backup', () => { downloadNow(); toast('Backup saved'); }, 12000);
  }
  async function boot() {
    try { if (navigator.storage && navigator.storage.persist) state.persisted = (await navigator.storage.persisted()) || (await navigator.storage.persist()); } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
    try { const rows = await list(); if (!rows[0] || Date.now() - rows[0].ts > 20 * 3600000) await snap('Daily'); } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
  }
  return { list, snap, restore, get, drop, download, downloadNow, fileInfo, remind, boot, state };
})();

/* ---- account.js ---- */
/* =====================================================================
   Accounts and team plans. Sign in with an email + a 6-digit code (or a recovery key), up to 5 devices.
   A paid "slot" is given to one team; that team then syncs to the cloud, opens on every signed-in device and unlocks
   stats, history, sharing, live links and backup. Free teams keep working on the phone with a small storage limit.
   ===================================================================== */
const Acct = (() => {
  const DAY = 86400000, GRACE = 60 * DAY, KEEP_GAMES = 3, KEEP_DAYS = 30, WARN_DAYS = 30;
  const PRICES = { month: [499, 425, 350], season: [2499, 2125, 1750], year: [3999, 3399, 2799] };
  const KIND = { month: 'Monthly', season: '6 months', year: '1 year' };
  const A = () => S.settings.acct || null;
  const emit = () => window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('st-acct'));
  const coded = (code, extra) => Object.assign(new Error(code), { code }, extra || {});
  const tierOf = n => (n >= 5 ? 2 : n >= 2 ? 1 : 0);
  const money = c => '$' + (c / 100).toFixed(2);
  const signedIn = () => !!(A() && A().dev);
  const plans = () => (A() && A().plans) || [];
  const stateOfPlan = p => { const n = Date.now(); return n < p.exp ? 'active' : n < p.exp + GRACE ? 'grace' : 'ended'; };
  const planFor = tid => { let best = null; plans().forEach(p => { if (p.tid === tid && (!best || p.exp > best.exp)) best = p; }); return best; };
  const stateOf = tid => { const p = planFor(tid); return p ? stateOfPlan(p) : 'free'; };
  const isMember = tid => { const c = Share.byTid(tid); return !!c && c.role !== 'owner'; };
  /* a team is "open" when its owner pays, or when I only joined it (the owner's plan covers me) */
  const unlocked = tid => isMember(tid) || stateOf(tid) === 'active';
  const activeCount = () => plans().filter(p => stateOfPlan(p) === 'active').length;
  const freeSlots = () => plans().filter(p => stateOfPlan(p) === 'active' && !p.tid);
  const statsOpen = T => !!T && (T.demo || S.teams.some(t => t.demo && t.mine) ? true : T.mine ? unlocked(T.id) : S.teams.some(t => t.mine && unlocked(t.id)));
  const backupOpen = () => activeCount() > 0 || S.teams.some(t => t.mine && isMember(t.id));
  const prices = () => (A() && A().prices) || PRICES;
  const unitPrice = (kind, qty) => prices()[kind][tierOf(activeCount() + qty)];
  const devName = () => { const ua = navigator.userAgent; return /iPhone/.test(ua) ? 'iPhone' : /iPad/.test(ua) ? 'iPad' : /Android/.test(ua) ? 'Android phone' : /Mac/.test(ua) ? 'Mac' : /Windows/.test(ua) ? 'Windows PC' : 'This device'; };

  async function call(path, body) {
    const b = Live.apiBase(); if (!b) throw coded('nosrv');
    const hd = { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }; if (A() && A().dev) hd['X-Dev'] = A().dev;
    const ctl = new AbortController(), to = setTimeout(() => ctl.abort(), 20000);
    try {
      const r = await fetch(b + path, { method: 'POST', headers: hd, body: JSON.stringify(body || {}), signal: ctl.signal });
      const j = await r.json().catch(() => ({}));
      if (!r.ok) {
        if (r.status === 401 && j.error === 'signed_out' && A() && A().dev) { S.settings.acct = { email: A().email, out: true, plans: [], devices: [] }; save('settings'); emit(); }
        throw coded(j.error || 'http' + r.status, { status: r.status, data: j });
      }
      return j;
    } catch (e) { if (e && e.name === 'AbortError') throw coded('timeout'); throw e; }
    finally { clearTimeout(to); }
  }
  const errText = e => ({
    nosrv: 'Open the app from your ShotPulse address first.', bad_email: 'That email address doesn’t look right.', bad_code: 'That code didn’t work. Check it, or ask for a new one.',
    bad_key: 'That recovery key doesn’t match this email.', too_many: 'Too many tries. Please wait a while and try again.', email_not_set_up: 'The server can’t send email yet. The owner needs to finish the email setup.',
    mail_failed: 'Couldn’t send the email. Try again in a minute.', signed_out: 'You were signed out on this device. Please sign in again.', payments_not_set_up: 'Payments aren’t switched on yet.',
    already_paid: 'That team already has a plan.', too_soon: 'A plan can be moved to another team once every 30 days.', bad_slot: 'That plan can’t be used right now.', timeout: 'That took too long. Try again.', bad_plan: 'That plan isn’t available. Pick another.', stripe: 'Stripe couldn’t start the payment' + (e && e.data && e.data.detail ? ': ' + e.data.detail : '. Check the Stripe key in the Worker settings.')
  })[e && e.code] || (e && e.data && e.data.hint) || (navigator.onLine ? 'Something went wrong. Try again.' : 'You’re offline. Connect and try again.');

  function store(me, dev) {
    const a = S.settings.acct || (S.settings.acct = {});
    if (dev) { a.dev = dev; a.out = false; }
    Object.assign(a, { email: me.email || a.email, devices: me.devices || [], plans: me.plans || [], max: me.max || 5, tier: me.tier, prices: me.prices || a.prices, ts: Date.now() });

  /* open the shared space of each paid team on this device (creates it the first time) */
  async function link() {

  async function removeDevice(id) { const me = await call('/api/acct/device/remove', { id }); store(me); return me; }

  async function assign(slotId, T) {
    store(await call('/api/acct/assign', { slot: slotId, tid: T.id, tname: T.name }));
    try { await Share.create(T); } catch (e) { /* the cloud copy starts at the next sync */ }

/* ---------- FAQ ---------- */
const FAQ = [
  ['Getting started', [
    ['What is ShotPulse?', 'A shot, goal and stats tracker for team sports. You tap as the game happens, and it keeps the score, shots, goals, penalties or fouls, shot locations and season stats for you. It works for hockey, ringette, basketball, soccer, lacrosse (box and field) and handball.'],
    ['How do I get started?', 'Open the Teams tab and tap New team. Pick the sport, give the team a name and colours, and add your goalies or players if you want. Then go to the Game tab and tap New game: choose your team, the opponent, and who is home, and you are tracking.'],
    ['Do I need an account or an internet connection?', 'Tracking a game needs no account and no signal. The app keeps your games on your phone and works fine in an arena with bad reception. An account (just your email, no password) is only needed for a team plan: cloud backup, opening your team on other devices, sharing and live links. Those catch up on their own once you have signal.'],
    ['Can I put it on my Home Screen like an app?', 'Yes. On iPhone, open it in Safari, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen. On Android, use the browser menu and choose Install app or Add to Home screen. On iPhone the Home Screen app keeps its own data, separate from Safari, so add your teams (or join your shared teams) in the Home Screen app.']]],
  ['Tracking a game', [
    ['How do I record a shot or a goal?', 'During a game, tap Shot when your team shoots on goal and Goal when they score. The big buttons are for your team; there are matching ones for the opponent. If shot locations are on, you tap where on the rink or court it came from. In basketball you pick 1, 2 or 3 points and made or missed.'],
    ['I tapped the wrong thing. How do I fix it?', 'Tap Undo to take back the last entry. To fix something older, open the game menu and use Fix shots & goals (Fix plays in basketball) to edit or remove any entry in the list.'],
    ['What are the period and clock settings?', 'You set the number of periods and how long each one is when you start a game, and your defaults live in Settings. The game clock is optional: turn it on if you want times on goals and penalties. The Period lengths button also covers overtime length.'],
    ['How do penalties, fouls and cards work?', 'Each sport shows the buttons it needs. Hockey and ringette have Penalty with the usual lengths and a power-play tracker. Basketball counts team fouls and shows when the bonus starts. Soccer has cards and fouls, and handball has suspensions and cards. All of them show up in the game summary.'],
    ['What is the STATS button?', 'It is a quick counter for extra things worth tracking in your sport, such as hits, takeaways and giveaways in hockey, rebounds and steals in basketball, or corners and offsides in soccer. These are tallies and do not change the score.'],
    ['Can the scorer window open by itself after a goal?', 'Yes. In Settings, turn on Scorer window for new games. The window for the goal scorer and assists then opens right after every goal (after the shot location, if that is on). You can also switch it on or off inside a game from Game options. If you leave it off, you get a Scorer button for a few seconds after each goal instead.'],
    ['What is the heat map on the team Stats page?', 'Under Shot quality, the shot map shows where your team shoots from over the whole season. Heat map mode colours busy areas warm (red, orange) and quiet areas cool (blue), so it stays readable after many games. Switch to Dots to see each shot. Use Shots and Goals to show either one or both, and Our shots or Shots against to flip ends. Only shots where you added a location are counted.'],
    ['Can I track each player’s shooting percentage in basketball?', 'Yes. After a basket or a miss, tap Scorer or Shooter and pick the jersey number (or let the window open by itself in Settings). The team Stats page then shows a Shooting table for each player with field goals, 3-pointers, free throws and their percentages. Only shots with a number count, and you can add or change a number later from Fix plays.'],
    ['Will my screen stay on while I track a game?', 'Yes. By default ShotPulse keeps your phone awake while the app is open and on screen. You can switch this off in Settings → Keep screen on. If your phone or browser does not support it, turn off auto-lock in your phone settings during games. It uses more battery, so plug in for long games.'],
    ['Can ShotPulse write a post about the game?', 'Yes. Open the game menu (or a finished game) and tap Game recap post. It writes a short social-media post from your stats: the score, the story of the game, the top scorers, shot counts, goalie saves and more. Edit the text if you like, tap Write it a different way for another version, then share or copy it. The more you track (scorer numbers, assists, goalies), the better the post.'],
    ['What is net placement?', 'An optional extra for every sport except basketball. After a shot or goal you tap where in the net it went, seen from the shooter, or outside the red frame if it missed the net. Turn it on in Settings (Net placement for new games) or per game in the game menu. The game page shows a net map for each team, and the Stats tab adds a Net placement section with a heat map or dots, Our shots or Shots against, and a count for each of nine spots in the net. You can also add or change a spot later from Fix shots & goals.'],
    ['Can I turn the shot map sideways?', 'Yes. In Settings → Shot map direction, choose Sideways. The rink (or court or field) turns so the net is on the right, the way a game looks from the stands. It changes where you tap a shot location and every shot map and heat map. Locations you already saved are kept and show correctly in either view.'],
    ['Can I choose which team defends the left or right net?', 'Yes. Turn the sideways shot map on, then open Game options → Which end is whose and pick the team whose net is on the left in the first period. The map then draws the net on the left or right to match where that team is attacking, and the teams swap ends automatically each period (at halftime in basketball and field lacrosse). You can also switch the sideways map on and off from Game options.'],
    ['Can two or more people track the same game?', 'Yes. Share the team (Teams tab → Invite people) so everyone is a Scorekeeper. When one phone starts the game, the others open it from their Game tab, History or Teams and tap Track this game too. Every play entered on every phone is combined into one game, even if a phone loses signal for a while. UNDO only removes plays you entered yourself. The top bar shows how many phones are tracking.'],
    ['How do we split the work between phones?', 'In a game, open Game options → This phone tracks. Choose Shots & goals for the person on the big SHOT and GOAL buttons, and Stats & penalties for the person counting hits, rebounds, faceoffs, penalties and fouls. Everything is combined into the same game. It only changes that phone’s screen.'],
    ['Can I put the stats I always track on the main screen?', 'Yes. Open STATS and tap PIN beside any stat. Pinned stats show as one-tap buttons under each team on the game screen, so you do not need to open STATS for them. Tap PINNED to remove one. Your choices are saved separately for each sport, and UNDO takes back the last tap.'],
    ['How do shootouts work?', 'When a game that can have a shootout (hockey, ringette, soccer, handball) is tied, the end-of-game screen offers a shootout. You record each attempt as scored or not, round by round, and it continues into sudden death if needed. Shootouts only appear for sports and games where they make sense.'],
    ['Can I track goalies?', 'Yes. In sports with a goalie, add your goalies on the team page, pick who is in net at the start, and change when a goalie is pulled or swapped. Save percentages and shots against are worked out per goalie.'],
    ['What does “Being tracked on another phone” mean?', 'Someone else on a shared team started that game. You can watch the latest saved version. Tap Track this game too to enter plays on your phone as well, or Take over if their phone died or they left.']]],
  ['Live link & spectators', [
    ['What is the live link?', 'A web link and QR code for a game. With a team plan, parents, grandparents and coaches who open it see the score, shots and goals update as you track, with no app to install and no account. After any game, the free plan can still share the final summary link. Start it from the game screen with Live link & QR.'],
    ['What do I need to use it?', 'Your ShotPulse server address filled in under Settings (Live server address). If you opened the app from your Worker address, it is already filled in. Your phone needs signal while you track; if it drops, the app keeps tracking and sends the updates when signal returns.'],
    ['What can spectators do?', 'Follow the score and the game as it happens, see shot maps and the scoring summary, and optionally turn on goal alerts and sounds on their own phone. They cannot change anything.'],
    ['How long does the live link last?', 'It follows the game while you track. Once the game is final, the link keeps showing the final score and summary for about 30 days, then it expires. You can also share a text summary from the finished game any time.']]],
  ['Shared teams', [
    ['What is a shared team?', 'It lets other people use the same team on their own phones for the whole season. Parents who keep stats can add games, and coaches can follow the stats and history. Everyone sees the same games and season totals.'],
    ['How do I share a team?', 'Open your team (Teams tab) and tap Share this team, then Invite people. Pick the teams to include, choose Scorekeeper or Viewer, and send the link or QR code. To share several teams at once, tap Invite people to my teams on the Teams tab.'],
    ['What is the difference between Scorekeeper and Viewer?', 'A Scorekeeper can start and track games and edit them. A Viewer can see stats, games and history but cannot change anything.'],
    ['Who controls who is on the team?', 'Only the owner (the person who created the team). Only the owner can invite people, see who has joined, remove someone, or stop sharing. People you add cannot invite others.'],
    ['How do I join a shared team?', 'Open the invite link you were sent, or on the Teams tab tap Join a team and paste the link. Enter your name so the owner knows who you are. You can join several teams from one link. Joining is free: the team owner’s plan covers you. (To open your own paid teams on another device, sign in with your email instead.)'],
    ['How do I use my teams on my computer or another phone?', 'With a team plan: on the other device open ShotPulse, tap the gear for Settings, tap Sign in or create account and enter the same email. Type the 6-digit code we email you and your paid teams open right away, and stay in sync both ways. You can be signed in on up to 5 devices; Settings, Devices lets you remove one.'],
    ['Is there a computer layout?', 'Yes. On a wide screen such as a laptop or desktop, ShotPulse switches to a layout with a menu on the left and the stats and history spread across the page. Tracking a game still uses the phone-style screen, since that is what the big buttons are made for.'],
    ['How long do invite links last?', 'Seven days, and each one works for the number of people the owner chose (1, 5 or 25). The owner can close open links any time. Once you have joined you stay on the team all season, until the owner removes you or you leave.'],
    ['How do I remove someone or stop sharing?', 'On the team page, tap People with access to see everyone and remove anyone. Stop sharing this team removes everyone’s access. People who were removed keep the copy they already had on their phone, but it stops updating.'],
    ['Why do my games not show up on someone else’s phone?', 'Phones sync when they have signal, about every 20 seconds while the app is open. Tap Sync now on the team page to force it. If a phone was offline, it catches up when it reconnects.']]],
  ['Stats & history', [
    ['Where do I see season stats?', 'The Stats tab shows totals for the team and each player or goalie, with the season you pick. The team page has a View team stats shortcut. The numbers are worked out from the games you tracked.'],
    ['Why do I only see some opponents?', 'Each of your teams only lists the opponents it has played. A team that only your other team has played does not show up. This applies to the Opponents list in History, the opponent picker in Stats, and the suggestions when you start a game. Type any name to add a new opponent. If another of your teams has played that name, ShotPulse reuses that opponent.'],
    ['What is in History?', 'Every finished game, newest first, with filters and a search. Open a game to see its scoring summary, shots by period, penalties, shot map and notes. You can share a summary as text or add notes from there.'],
    ['Can I fix a finished game?', 'Yes. Open the game in History and tap Reopen game to edit, make the changes, and finish it again. You can also edit notes, or delete the game.'],
    ['How do I send a game summary to parents?', 'Open the finished game and tap Share game summary. It makes a text summary you can send in any messaging app.']]],
  ['Sports & settings', [
    ['Can I change a team’s sport later?', 'Only before the team has games. After that the sport is fixed so your stats stay consistent. If you need another sport, create a new team.'],
    ['Can I change period lengths, overtime and other defaults?', 'Yes. The starting values are common ones for each sport; open Settings or the Period lengths button when starting a game to set what your league uses. They are saved as your defaults.'],
    ['What are the screen style and Glare settings?', 'Display options in Settings. Glare is a high-contrast mode for bright arenas or outdoor fields.'],
    ['Do I have to keep the screen on?', 'While tracking, the app asks your phone to keep the screen awake. If your phone locks anyway, the game is not lost: it is saved after every entry.']]],
  ['Backups & your data', [
    ['Where is my data stored?', 'On your phone, in the app. A team with a plan is also kept in the cloud so it can open on your other devices and be shared. Game summary links and live links are sent to your ShotPulse server only when you start them.'],
    ['How do I back up my data?', 'Settings has Save backup file now and Automatic backup history. A daily and after-each-game backup is kept on the phone, and you can save a file to keep elsewhere. Import backup brings it back on a new phone.'],
    ['I got a new phone. How do I move my teams?', 'Sign in on the new phone with the same email (Settings, Sign in) and your teams with a team plan open automatically. If you lost access to your email, use your recovery key instead. For a team on the free plan, save a backup copy on the old phone and use Import backup on the new one. Teams that someone else shared with you need a fresh invite from the owner.'],
    ['Can I restore a backup while a team is shared?', 'Not while teams are shared on that phone, so a restore cannot overwrite everyone’s games. Stop sharing or leave the team first.'],
    ['What does Erase all data do?', 'It deletes every team and game on this phone. If you share or have joined teams, it asks you to stop sharing or leave them first, so nobody else loses their copy. Save a backup first if you might want it back.']]]
